items.review_note: current Liên Sơn commune remains unresolved for creation; release Q30923256 to the former Văn Chấn agricultural township
items.review_rationale: The current Liên Sơn commune was formed from the former NT Liên Sơn township, Sơn A, and Nghĩa Phúc, but no separate current item or article was found. Q30923256 retains the township class, former Văn Chấn parent, old coordinates, and GeoNames 8526358 for `Thị Trấn Nông Trường Liên Sơn`.

items.review_note: current Vụ Bản commune remains unresolved for creation; release the unrelated former Bình Lục commune Q10833773
items.review_rationale: The current `Vụ Bản (xã)` article documents its June 2025 formation from Gôi, Kim Thái, and Tam Thanh and reports no connected Wikidata item. Q10833773 instead has the Vũ Bản name and alias, former Bình Lục district parent, historical coordinates, GeoNames 8564019, and the old `Vũ Bản` article.
